scenes.text: To find a fraction of a quantity, divide into denominator-sized groups, then take the numerator number of groups.
Calculate 6/8 of 24. The answer is 18. One 8th of 24 is 3; multiply by 6 to get 18.
2/3 of 24 reading cards are used during a library project. How many cards is that? Pause the video and think.
2/3 of 24 reading cards are used during a library project. How many cards is that? The answer is 16. One 3th of 24 is 8; multiply by 2 to get 16.
